method: Ran the ignored native incremental-index profile against a marked disposable copy under /private/tmp. The copy included the selected snapshot manifest, its non-secret captured objects, and its existing parser index. Only copied src/font.rs bytes were changed; the original app storage was untouched. No model, speech, or Fontdone code execution.
limitations: One local run without a variance estimate.
The copied snapshot had a prepared syntax index; this is not a cold parser-index build.
The profile does not test real mid-copy cancellation, packaged behavior, Codex tool choice, answer quality, or semantic relevance of broad results.
Broad first-page retrieval still misses seven of twelve independently selected expected spans.
